vlog_arc.theme: Building in public: the real cost of showing up every day

beats.mon: Leo opens on a quiet morning scene, naming the exact moment the afternoon crash used to hit him before Power Coffee existed.
beats.tue: He walks through his actual training session before work, tying physical discipline to the same discipline behind the brand.
beats.wed: Mid-week, he sits down to confess one real formulation mistake from the early days and what it taught him.
beats.thu: He shares a short, unscripted clip of reading a customer review that caught him off guard, no script, just reaction.
beats.fri: He breaks down the $0.73-a-morning math on camera, holding up nothing but a notebook, keeping it plain and calm.
beats.sat: Family day — Leo shows a few minutes of real weekend time with his kids, tying purpose back to why he built this.
beats.sun: He closes the week with a quiet reflection on faith, discipline, and why consistency matters more than any single win.
